item.description: I was dismayed to learn of the Park District of Oak Park’s plan to demolish the beloved, 50-meter outdoor pool at Ridgeland Common (RC) in order to build an indoor 25-yard pool on the same site. item.title: You never know
item.description: Conventional wisdom has long advised against conversations on politics and religion. But the more conventional the wisdom, the greater my desire to prove it wrong.
